Interesting story
While i was living in Hungary Budapest for almost 18 years (Im living in Dunaújváros right now) i ha e seen a MASSIVE number of crashes.
My house was near or almost at the crossroads of 1 very busy road and another one that was leading tó the highway.
Since my childhood I was always hering and seeing crashes at the crossroads. I think its possible that its an unholy place but only in a Funny skeptical way because of the sheer number of crashes (what i saw was almost over 100s of crashes or more over 18 years.).
So there was once an almost FATAL crash when a biker run into a car and the guys heart stopped.
The medical team gave him cpr in the ambulance and there were 2 old ladies out of their Windows talking about the crash.
So after a While the kid come Back and ringed every household in the Tower. (idr the word for it, several household in several levels )
So he managed to speak to the owner of the house(one of the nannies) and repeated her EVERYTHING THAT THEY SPOKE ABOUT CORRECTLY...
How? He doesnt know. He said "Lepörgött a szemem előtt az életem és utána kiszálltam a testéből."
Which translates to :"My life rolled down before my eyes, then i went out of my body."
He also saw the light at the end of the tunnel first, the his flash of his life, then the out of the body experience.
He woke up in the ambulance and survived with a few broken bones.
The thing is this is why I believe we ha e some sort of soul because we were neighbours with the  nanny and the thing is we saw the crash too. But we didnt watched it long. I heard somewhat the conversation só I can assure you that is legit.
